# AI usage

AI agents wrote most of this repo's code and documentation. Humans chose the idea, made the decisions, and do everything that needs a key, a wallet or a judgement call on Etherscan. All plans, prompts and reports are in [docs/planning/](planning/).

## The reference Guard is AI-generated
**`contracts/` starts from `11_HexFence_Guard_reference`, a reference `HexFenceGuard` generated by AI (Claude), with its tests.** In task T1 an AI agent reviewed it against spec §3.1 and left its logic unchanged. It added a Hardhat `.env` loader, a deploy script that refuses non-Sepolia chains, and one test for the ready-made synthetic pair (14 tests pass against the real Safe 1.4.1 contracts). *Human review of the Guard: name the reviewer here (team to confirm).*

## Who did what

| Lane | Agent | Account | Tasks |
|---|---|---|---|
| A: core + data | Claude Code | Deven | T0, T1 review, T2 `packages/shared`, T4 `packages/arkiv`, T3 `apps/detector`, T13 sample and precision tooling, Guard-to-client parity test |
| B: HexFence Pay | Claude Code (Sonnet) | Dhruv | T6 `apps/pay` (and T10, T11, T12 as they land) |
| C: explorer + docs | Claude Code (Opus), planned for Codex | Dhruv | T5 `apps/explorer`, T9 Verify on Ethereum, T7 these docs, `docs/DEMO.md` |

Dhruv's Claude Code session also acted as organiser for Lane B: it wrote the Lane B plan and checked that session's results. Lane C was planned for Codex and was done by Claude Code instead, because that account had usage left. The per-task history, with commit hashes, is in the logs in [docs/lanes/](lanes/).

## How the agents worked
Rules are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [docs/PARALLEL_PLAN.md](PARALLEL_PLAN.md): one agent per lane, each editing only its own paths, meeting through the frozen signatures in [docs/INTERFACES.md](INTERFACES.md), with tests before each commit.

## What humans do
- Choose the idea and approve the spec (v4).
- Create keys, use faucets, deploy, and operate Safe{Wallet} (H1–H3, H5).
- Run the manual payment tests (H6, H7).
- Hand-label 30 detector records on Etherscan (H9). The precision number comes from these labels, not from an AI.
- Have a native speaker check the Hindi (H10).
- Record the video (H8), and host the apps (H11).

## How AI output was checked
- **Guard:** 14 tests against real Safe contracts, and a parity test checking the client's verdict against the real Guard's decision on 411 transactions.
- **Detector:** 40 of 40 random records from a real run were confirmed against mainnet receipts.
- **Verify on Ethereum:** tests use real saved mainnet receipts for both variants, plus broken records that must not pass.
- **Not checkable by AI:** real wallet behaviour on Sepolia. That is what H6 and H7 are for.
